title: Cache Locally, Recompute Selectively for Streaming Video Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2610.29229v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Streaming video understanding (SVU) requires video-LLMs to process incoming video continuously while answering user queries with low latency. Recent methods reduce query-time cost by prefilling frames into KV caches during idle time and reusing the cached KVs at query time. To bound per-frame computation over unbounded video streams, these methods restrict the context available during prefill. This creates a fundamental context mismatch: the restricted context may omit information needed to properly contextualize video tokens, yet, still contain information irrelevant to the eventual query, which is unknown during prefill. We propose FrameBlend, a simple yet effective plug-and-play method to address this mismatch through selective KV recomputation, without requiring any additional training. At query time, FrameBlend re-prefills selected video tokens using query-relevant context and replaces their cached KVs with recomputed ones. Crucia

translated_title: 面向流式视频理解的局部缓存与选择性重算
translated_abstract: 流式视频理解（SVU）要求视频大语言模型在持续处理不断输入的视频的同时，以低延迟回答用户查询。近期方法通过在空闲时段将帧预填充至KV缓存，并在查询时复用缓存的KV，来降低查询时的计算开销。为了在无界的视频流上控制每帧的计算量，这些方法在预填充时限制了可用的上下文。这导致了一个根本性的上下文不匹配问题：受限的上下文可能遗漏了正确理解视频标记（video tokens）所需的信息，同时又包含了与最终查询无关的信息，而查询内容在预填充阶段是未知的。我们提出FrameBlend，一种简单而有效的即插即用方法，通过选择性的KV重算来解决这一不匹配问题，且无需任何额外训练。在查询时，FrameBlend使用与查询相关的上下文对选定的视频标记进行重新预填充，并用重算得到的KV替换原有的缓存KV。至关重要的是……（原文摘要于此处截断）
tldr: 提出无需训练的即插即用方法FrameBlend，通过在查询时利用查询相关上下文对选定视频标记的KV缓存进行选择性重算，解决了流式视频理解中的上下文不匹配问题。
en_tdlr: FrameBlend is a training-free, plug-and-play method that resolves the context mismatch in streaming video understanding by selectively recomputing the KV caches of selected video tokens using query-relevant context at query time.
